records.lease_details: 125-year lease; former public lavatory comprising gentlemen's 364 sq ft and ladies' 299 sq ft rooms; residential planning had been ruled out by Islington Council; purchaser reported intention to convert to offices.
records.notes: Contemporary 12 April 2012 report identifies the property as described in FPD Savills' catalogue and reports an auction sale at £182,000 against £75,000 reserve/guide wording. Exact auction date and lot number are not asserted because the surviving report does not safely establish them. Capture-first record retained rather than blocking on identity reconstruction.

notes: Breadth-first Savills 2012 commercial source capture. Unknown exact auction identity remains null by design; enrichment is deferred.
